newsitem.title: UK: Safeway weak after retail report.
newsitem.headline: Safeway weak after retail report.

text.p: Shares in Safeway Plc edged lower on Tuesday in a mixed supermarket sector after a retail industry report found continued downward pressure on food prices, dealers said,

The British Retail Consortium said its retail sales monitor for March found non-food retailers continuing to report stronger growth yet in food retailers "the downward pressue on prices is particularly noticeable".
In a mostly higher UK equity market, Safeway Plc was down 1-1/2p at 347 and ASDA Group Plc was down 3/4p at 110-1/2. "The BRC report was not good news for the food retailers," said one dealer.
